statement: Claude Pro can generate several thousand to tens of thousands of lines of code per month depending on usage, model, context size and task type.
src/extract/prompt.js performs a second redaction stage: everything sent to a provider passes through redact() independently of capture-time redaction, and uses a fixed cache-friendly system prompt.
rationale: Observed in source audit of extraction prompt code.

statement: Groq structured outputs support strict json_schema only on some models; schema-mismatch responses return HTTP 400 'Generated JSON does not match the expected schema'. Rate-limit headers expose RPD/TPM; gpt-oss-20b is 30 RPM / 1K RPD / 8K TPM / 200K TPD.
rationale: Fetched from live Groq docs during session.

statement: Update L-1bbf8cb8: Groq limits confirmed live — 429s on TPM (8,000 tokens/min) are retried successfully after a wait; daily limit of 1,000 RPD confirmed.
rationale: Rate-limit handling is now confirmed working live.

statement: After a quota/credit error MEMO sets a cooldown pause that blocks all provider runs (including Groq) until the cooldown expires; `src/llm/limits.clearCooldown()` clears it, and saving a new key also clears the cooldown.
rationale: Error message says 'no API call before 19:15'; assistant cleared cooldown via limits.clearCooldown(); key.js save calls limits.clearCooldown().

statement: scripts/codebase-summary.js: first run (or --full) sends tracked files (~101 files, ~126k input tokens) to build a full summary; later runs send previous summary + git diff since the base commit + untracked files. Base commit is stored as a comment on line 1 of codebase_summary.md. Model can be changed via MEMO_SUMMARY_MODEL env var. All content passes through src/redact.js; .specstory/, transcripts, *.patch, memory/ and *_key.md are excluded.

Why Copilot/other agents lack context: (1) Claude Code gets context pushed via a SessionStart hook while Copilot only gets a 4-line pointer it usually never opens; (2) only Claude Code sessions are captured so Copilot's work never reaches .memory/; (3) user preferences live outside the repo in ~/.claude/; (4) PROJECT_STATE.md was stale due to the Groq 401 failures. The earlier proposed decisions/ and errors/ folder plan was retracted as redundant with records/*.jsonl and PROJECT_STATE.md.
rationale: Explained in assistant_text after inspecting the repo; the repo already had copilot-instructions.md and records/*.jsonl, so the earlier proposed decisions/errors folder layout was withdrawn as unnecessary.

statement: Node heredoc (stdin) scripts repeatedly fail on Windows shells due to escaping mismatches (backslashes, newlines) — prefer the Edit tool for multi-line replacements; a heredoc attempt on scripts/codebase-summary.js threw 'miss' and left the file unchanged.
rationale: Repeated heredoc/stdin edit attempts failed with mismatched strings and were redone safely with the Edit tool; no file was corrupted in this session.

statement: Default prices now merge in src/config.js so z-ai/glm-5.3-flash costs are computed even on old installs that lack the model in their prices list; previously cost showed 'unknown'.
rationale: Prevents 'unknown' cost display for the new default model on older installs.

statement: Copilot's chat-history tool returns only chat titles and dates with empty transcripts; this is a Copilot limitation and cannot be fixed. A note was added to copilot-instructions.md that past chat results live in the snapshot and .memory/sessions/**/*.md.
rationale: Documents a Copilot platform limitation the user should know.

statement: Claude Desktop stores claude-code-sessions and local-agent-mode-sessions under %APPDATA%/Claude, but neither contained any whisper_flow_hackathon matches — Claude chat conversations are not saved locally in a usable form, so they cannot currently be imported into MEMO.
rationale: User asked that Claude (chat) conversations be captured too; investigation found no local data.

statement: Copilot chat history is now captured into MEMO via the new ~/.copilot/session-state adapter (src/capture/copilot.js), substantially closing the gap that Copilot's work never reached .memory/; note in copilot-instructions.md about snapshot locations remains relevant.

Session-history database (SQL) contains no sessions matching whisper_flow_hackathon within 30 days (only an unrelated 12 Oct Copilot-worktree session 'what can you do'), so old chat context cannot come from the local session store.
